info.title: Opus Library Read-Along & OPDS API
info.description: Open OPDS 1.2, OPDS 2.0, W3C Web Publication Manifest, and Read-Along Book API hosted on Cloudflare Pages & D1.

get.summary: W3C / Readium Web Publication Manifest for a book
List public books (and authenticated user's private books)

post.summary: Create a new book (requires session cookie)

get.summary: Get full book JSON, chapters, segments, and word-by-word timestamps

put.summary: Update book Cast, Emotion, Ambiance & SFX script (owner only)

post.summary: Queue a render job in Cloudflare D1 render_jobs (owner only)
